summary: The diff implements much of the navy+gold luxury rebrand (new CSS variable palette via OKLCH, premium typography, leather texture overlay, updated header with gold logo and desktop underline active state, updated cards/accordions with softer shadows and gold accents). However, some explicit requirements are either not evidenced (required generated image assets) or appear partially unmet (mobile active-state still uses a filled background; button hover inversion not shown). There are also unrequested changes/features (taxonomy structure changes, extra footer attribution/tracking, SubcategoryCard component).

missing_requirements.requirement: Use the exact specified hex colors for the navy+gold palette (#0F1B2D, #141F33, #C8A24D, #F4EFE6, #B9933C) across the entire frontend.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff updates CSS variables using OKLCH channel values, but does not provide evidence that these values map exactly to the required hex colors (requirement calls for exact colors).

missing_requirements.requirement: Active nav item is indicated via a subtle gold underline/marker (not a solid filled background) on both desktop and mobile menus.
missing_requirements.reason: Desktop shows an underline span, but the mobile active state is shown using a filled background (`bg-primary/5`) which conflicts with the acceptance criteria; the truncated mobile underline implementation cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Buttons site-wide: primary gold fill with navy text; secondary/outline gold borders with cream text; hover should invert (gold ↔ navy) with smooth transitions and subtle elevation.
missing_requirements.reason: `btn-primary` hover state is `hover:bg-primary/90` plus slight scale and shadow, but no evidence of color inversion to navy-on-hover (or vice versa). `btn-secondary` definition is truncated, so the required inversion behavior cannot be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide required static image assets under frontend/public/assets/generated: leather texture tile (leather-texture-tile.dim_1024x1024.png), transparent logo (meghraj-logo-transparent.dim_800x800.png), gold-only logo (meghraj-logo-gold.dim_800x800.png), and square mark (meghraj-mark-square.dim_512x512.png).
missing_requirements.reason: No new files were added in the diff, yet the code references `/assets/generated/leather-texture-tile.dim_1024x1024.png` and `/assets/generated/meghraj-logo-gold.dim_800x800.png`; there is no evidence the required images were created/placed under the specified static assets directory.
